Groceries and everyday essentials from your neighbourhood store.

Open Nook in your phone’s browser to add it to your home screen.

Open customer app →

On Android

  1. Open this page in Chrome.
  2. Tap Install customer app when available, or the browser menu → Add to Home screen / Install app.

On iPhone or iPad

  1. Open this page in Safari.
  2. Tap Share → Add to Home Screen.
  3. Tap Add to keep Nook on your home screen.

This is an installable web demo, not an App Store or APK download. Login, payments, orders and distances are simulated.
